description: Find sound effects, music beds and ambience for your video in the Switch Motion Sound Library (952 level matched sounds: whooshes, swooshes, transitions, hits, chimes, UI clicks, typing, risers, glitches, logo stingers, ambient and music beds). Open on the Switch owner's account only for now (any other account is refused: make an effect with generate_sound_effect or a music bed with generate_music there). On the owner's account, use it before making any new sound effect: the library comes first and only a few effects go in a video, one per real moment. Returns the best matches with sound_id, description, length, seconds and an audio_url to use. Optional length: short (about 1 s), medium (1 to 2.5 s) or long; limit defaults to 5 (max 12).

length.description: Optional. short is about 1 s or less, medium 1 to 2.5 s, long over 2.5 s.

limit.description: How many sounds, best match first. Default 5, max 12.

search.description: What the moment needs, in plain words, e.g. "soft photo flip swoosh", "slow thoughtful typing", "calm piano music bed".
